title: Comment on “Design, synthesis, anticancer activity and molecular docking of quinoline-based dihydrazone derivatives” by J.-X. Lu, H.-R. Lan, D. Zeng, J.-Y. Song, Y.-T. Hao, A.-P. Xing, A. Shen, and J. Yuan, RSC Adv., 2025, 15, 231–243
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44437-44438
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00388A, Comment

Ralf Weiskirchen
This comment critically evaluates a study by Lu and colleagues, highlighting the misidentification and HeLa cell contamination in the three cell lines used to evaluate the anticancer properties of quinoline-based dihydrazone derivatives.
